notes:
MediciToken has no constructor arguments and no minting entry point after construction. MediciHook takes only PoolManager and the launch token, then creates and permanently binds MediciTreasury and MediciFeeRouter; their addresses are exposed by treasury() and feeRouter(). There is no owner, upgrade, pause or configurable fee. Only the PoolManager can invoke hook callbacks. beforeInitialize accepts one native ETH/MEDICI pool with fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60. Hook address permission bits are 0x20cc. The manifest initialPrice is the required nominal value; the deployer derives the opening price from launch policy.

The hook charges ETH on actual swap deltas for exact-in and exact-out buys and sells: a base 150 bps to treasury and 50 bps accrued for TEAM. Buy fees decay linearly from 5000 to 200 bps over the first 900 seconds, with the surplus going to treasury; treasury swaps are exempt. claimTeam() is permissionless. When the PoolManager lacks ETH during the callback, fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims, redeemable through redeemFees() or claimTeam(). Its arithmetic accumulator supplies the 24-hour, or since-open, ETH-per-MEDICI TWAP and epoch valuation without an external oracle.

Initial treasury roles are TEAM 0x01670a5cfaeeaee388cd38085c4adf1bad45a1c2 and KEEPER 0x16578e0dfafa219f2b0f52095d8206b5c02f8250; each role can only transfer itself. Fixed integrations are LaunchFactory 0x12c63b581d07093f6126bc02263c58f7eadaa96f, ProjectFactory 0xff03410d0fe5fa8f7f59f743de35e333d9857120, Intake 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82 and IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. Both companions receive native ETH and send it with call. No launch number is a constructor input: anyone binds the router once via setLaunchNumber(n), which verifies LaunchFactory.positionOf(n).key.hooks. The paying wallet then calls LaunchFactory.setRequester(n, feeRouter). harvest() requires both steps, claims fees and withdraws both currencies; ETH goes to current TEAM and MEDICI is burned through treasury.

Treasury implements weekly burn voting with proposal hashes and emitted briefs, capped late-vote extensions, settlement, epoch-TWAP quorum and escrowed proposer bounties. Intake commissions pay exactly 0.5 IMD for launch.open@launch-1; insufficient IMD triggers an exact-output 0.5 IMD purchase capped at 0.03 ETH in the unhooked ETH/IMD pool with fee 10000 and tickSpacing 200. Authenticated live-request callbacks, keeper skips and 14-day lapses handle runner-up promotion. Recorded launches require treasury requester ownership and at least 5% of the launch token supply available for backers; winning voters claim pro rata for 90 days, then unclaimed tokens can be burned. Failed bounty transfers remain escrowed and retryable via claimBounty(). Settlement unlocks 40% of epoch ETH income over 24 hours for MEDICI buybacks; unused funds carry, the caller receives a 0.5% ETH tip from the budget, and minimum output is 95% of the TWAP quote. Keeper withdrawals are capped at 0.01 ETH per epoch. Recorded-launch harvests preserve backer reserves and retain IMD. Burns send tokens to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead; totalBurned counts treasury MEDICI burns, including buybacks.
